entries.test: Whether Anthropic's June 2026 'When AI builds itself' blog presents evidence beyond human-directed coding speedups and benchmark gains, such as autonomous AI-driven development of a successor system.
entries.note: Only the factual core about what the blog showed can be graded. 'Bait and switch' and the claim that Anthropic is trying to strike terror describe motive and are rhetorical.
Readers would disagree on how to split credit between scaling and harnesses or tools. They would also disagree on whether harnesses count as neurosymbolic systems.

entries.test: Whether Marcus's earlier public writings, such as his 2022 essay 'Deep Learning Is Hitting a Wall', claimed AI or deep learning would hit a wall or only argued for hybrid neurosymbolic supplementation.
entries.note: The claim has two parts. The second, 'that's exactly what happened', rests on contested definitions of neurosymbolic AI.
